throughline.zh: AI 供應鏈升級、專利調查與能源安全，讓企業同時面對技術、法律及營運限制。
throughline.en: AI upgrades, patent proceedings and energy insecurity expose distinct technology, legal and operating constraints.

verificationNote.zh: 10/12 回溯補編：依先前日報主題重建，採用 10/12 台灣時間 08:00 前已發布的報導主題；非完整原文復刻。8 則已重新檢索來源。USITC 立案不代表侵權成立，交易與停火消息未定。部分來源其後更新，無法保證逐字恢復當時版本。
verificationNote.en: Retrospective October 12 edition reconstructed from prior topics, not a verbatim restoration. Eight stories have recovered sources published before 08:00 Taipei. Some source pages later changed; original versions cannot be fully restored. Investigations, deal talks and ceasefire claims remain unresolved.

title.zh: USITC 啟動垂直供電系統調查，台灣供應鏈列入被訴方
title.en: USITC opens a vertical power-delivery investigation

summary.zh: USITC 於 10/9 依 Vicor 申訴啟動 337-TA-1526，涉及垂直供電系統及含有相關元件的運算系統。台達電等公司列為被訴方。
summary.en: On October 9, the USITC opened case 337-TA-1526 following a Vicor complaint about vertical power-delivery and computing systems, naming Delta and other respondents.

metricLabel.zh: 美國關稅法第 337 條調查

text.zh: 分析：若最終認定侵權並核發排除命令，可能影響輸美產品。立案本身尚未決定侵權或進口限制。
text.en: Analysis: an eventual exclusion order could affect US imports. Opening an investigation does not establish infringement.

text.zh: Vicor 要求有限排除命令與停止及禁止命令。需追蹤審理與裁決，不能把申訴當成定案。
text.en: Vicor requests exclusion and cease-and-desist orders; track proceedings and the eventual ruling.

confidence.zh: 高：官方立案；未定：侵權結果

title.zh: TPCA 展將聚焦先進封裝與玻璃核心，量產門檻仍待突破
title.en: TPCA preview highlights packaging and glass-core challenges

summary.zh: 10/11 中央社報導，10/20 至 22 日電路板展將關注先進封裝與玻璃基板。玻璃核心仍在技術驗證及供應鏈建構階段。
summary.en: CNA’s October 11 preview of the October 20–22 PCB show highlights advanced packaging and glass cores, which remain under validation.

text.zh: 分析：大型 AI 封裝把要求傳到載板、材料與設備，玻璃核心的機會需與製程可靠度一起評估。
text.en: Analysis: larger AI packages raise demands on substrates, materials and equipment; reliability matters alongside potential benefits.

text.zh: 仍有脆性、通孔金屬化與可靠度挑戰。官方頁面與新聞的品牌及攤位數不同，本期不採用該規模數字。
text.en: Challenges include brittleness, via metallization and reliability. Conflicting exhibitor counts are omitted.

confidence.zh: 高：展期；中：技術發展判斷

title.zh: 利雅德機場遇襲，航空營運受到干擾

summary.zh: Reuters 10/10 至 11 日報導，利雅德機場遇襲至少 12 人死亡、逾 300 人受傷，航班改降、機場營運暫停。
summary.en: Reuters reported at least 12 deaths and over 300 injuries after the airport attack, with flights diverted and operations suspended.

metricLabel.zh: 當時報導的死亡人數，可能修訂
metricLabel.en: Reported deaths at the time; subject to revision

text.zh: 分析：民航樞紐中斷可能增加航線調整及運輸成本，不能直接等同石油供應已中斷。
text.en: Analysis: hub disruptions may raise routing costs, without proving an oil-supply outage.

text.zh: 人數沿用當時報導。攻擊責任與軍方說法須區分，後續調查仍待追蹤。
text.en: Counts reflect contemporary reporting. Attribution and military claims require further scrutiny.

confidence.zh: 高：已報導中斷；中：成本影響
confidence.en: High: reported disruption. Medium: cost impact.

title.zh: 川普宣布俄烏能源停火，雙方落實情況仍不明

summary.zh: AP 10/11 報導川普宣布俄烏能源停火，但未提供細節；烏方仍通報能源設施遭攻擊，俄方未立即評論。
summary.en: AP reported Trump’s announcement without details, while Kyiv reported continued attacks and Moscow did not immediately comment.

metricLabel.zh: 宣布與履行須分開判讀

text.zh: 分析：能源設施安全可能影響供應預期，但政治宣布不能當作實際供應增加。
text.en: Analysis: infrastructure security may affect supply expectations; an announcement is not restored supply.

text.zh: 需核對正式條款、雙方確認與可觀察的履行情況。這裡保留 10/11 報導的狀態。
text.en: Check terms, confirmation by both sides and observable compliance. This entry preserves the October 11 status.

confidence.zh: 高：宣布；低：履行是否成立

title.zh: 世界銀行與 30 至 40 國討論危機援助
title.en: World Bank discusses crisis aid with 30–40 countries

summary.zh: 世銀行長 Banga 在 10/11 Reuters 訪問表示，正與 30 至 40 國討論潛在危機援助，因應能源衝擊與價格上升。
summary.en: Banga told Reuters on October 11 that 30–40 countries were discussing possible crisis aid amid energy shocks and rising prices.

metricLabel.zh: 與世銀討論的國家數，行長說法
metricLabel.en: Countries in dialogue, according to Banga

text.zh: 分析：燃料成本會傳到財政與融資壓力；討論援助尚不代表核准或撥款。
text.en: Analysis: fuel costs can strain budgets and financing; discussions do not mean approved or disbursed aid.

text.zh: 需追蹤援助條件與實際撥款。本期未取得對應世銀一手公告，以訪問報導為依據。
text.en: Track conditions and disbursements. No matching primary release was recovered; this relies on the interview.

confidence.zh: 中高：具名訪問；未定：援助結果
confidence.en: Medium-high: named interview. Unresolved: aid outcome.

title.zh: 吉布地移民船翻覆，IOM 通報至少 139 人死亡
title.en: IOM reports at least 139 deaths in Djibouti shipwreck

summary.zh: AP 10/11 引述 IOM，逾 300 名移民搭乘的船隻翻覆，至少 139 人死亡，包括兒童。
summary.en: AP cited IOM on October 11: at least 139 people, including children, died when a boat carrying over 300 migrants capsized.

text.zh: 這是移民安全與救援事件。人道援助需求應與地區商業及能源議題分開呈現。
text.en: This is a migration-safety and rescue emergency; humanitarian needs deserve their own treatment.

text.zh: IOM 說死亡數只涵蓋官方已核實者，可能再增加；幸存者需要醫療及心理支持。
text.en: IOM said the count included officially verified deaths and could rise; survivors needed medical and psychological support.

confidence.zh: 高：IOM 具名說法；未定：最終人數
confidence.en: High: named IOM attribution. Unresolved: final count.

title.zh: Yandex 稱第三座資料中心受襲停機，部分服務不可用
title.en: Yandex reports another data-center shutdown after attack

summary.zh: Reuters 10/11 引述 Yandex，公司 Vladimir 地區資料中心因無人機攻擊停機，部分服務無法使用。報導稱這是數日內第三座受影響大型資料中心。
summary.en: Reuters cited Yandex on October 11: its Vladimir-region facility shut down after a drone attack, with some services unavailable, the third major facility affected in days.

metricLabel.zh: 數日內受影響大型資料中心，報導統計
metricLabel.en: Major facilities affected in days, per reporting

text.zh: 分析：資料中心地理集中與備援安排是服務連續性的風險，不能直接推論所有 AI 算力已消失。
text.en: Analysis: geographic concentration and redundancy matter for continuity; the report does not establish a total loss of AI capacity.

text.zh: 停機依公司說法，完整容量、影響範圍與恢復時間尚未取得。
text.en: Shutdown is company-reported; capacity, full impact and recovery time remain unverified.

confidence.zh: 中高：公司說法經報導；未定：完整影響
confidence.en: Medium-high: reported company statement. Unresolved: full impact.

title.zh: 媒體稱 Amazon 洽購 Decart，交易尚未宣布

summary.zh: Reuters 10/11 轉述 WSJ 的知情人士報導，Amazon 正洽購 Decart，可能估值約 70 億美元。這是交易洽談消息，尚非正式成交。
summary.en: Reuters relayed a WSJ report of talks for Amazon to buy Decart at roughly $7 billion; no completed deal was announced.

metricLabel.zh: 媒體報導的可能交易估值

text.zh: 分析：若交易成真，可能牽動 AI 軟體整合；僅憑洽談消息，無法認定收購動機與收益。
text.en: Analysis: a deal could affect AI software integration, but talks alone do not establish motives or benefits.

text.zh: 依匿名消息報導，未有雙方正式交易公告；條件、完成時間與是否成交皆待確認。
text.en: Anonymous-source reporting; terms, timing and completion remain unconfirmed.

confidence.zh: 中：媒體洽談消息；未定：成交

question.zh: 供電專利如何影響 AI 供應鏈？
question.en: How could power patents affect the AI supply chain?

text.zh: 先看官方程序，再追蹤可能的產品與進口限制。
text.en: Start with the official proceeding and potential product restrictions.

question.zh: 玻璃核心離量產還有多遠？
question.en: How far are glass cores from production?

text.zh: 把材料優勢與可靠度、製程驗證分開閱讀。
text.en: Separate material potential from process and reliability validation.

question.zh: 洽談估值能代表收購價值嗎？
question.en: Does a reported valuation establish acquisition value?

text.zh: 區分媒體消息、正式交易與尚待證明的綜效。
text.en: Distinguish reporting, a signed deal and unproven synergies.

text.zh: 分析：專利程序、材料驗證與營運安全分屬不同風險，應使用裁決、良率與可用率等不同證據評估。
text.en: Analysis: legal proceedings, material validation and operational safety require different evidence, such as rulings, yields and uptime.

title.zh: AI 系統風險：技術以外的限制

text.zh: 追蹤 USITC 程序、封裝驗證與服務恢復；目前證據不足以量化共同財務影響。
text.en: Track proceedings, packaging validation and service restoration; evidence is insufficient to quantify a combined financial impact.
